releaseNotes:
OmniControl Suite v8.16.1 - Complete Hardware Fixes & Google Stitch OLED Redesign:
- GPU Sleep & Optimus Lock Fix: Completely isolated dGPU telemetry during sleep to eliminate polling wakeups, allowing RTX 4060 to stay in 0.0W D3Cold.
- Eco Mode Performance & Power Governor: Optimized EPP to 80 (Responsive Efficient) and capped boost at 99% for smooth 2.4-3.8GHz responsiveness at cool 42°C.
- AC Reconnection Fix: Synchronously unlocks full 100% Turbo clocks and boosts on charger, eliminating halved FPS.
- Elevated Startup: Task Scheduler autostart with highest admin privileges.
- Native Resolution & High DPI: Enabled PerMonitorV2 scaling for razor-sharp text and graphics.
- Battery Diagnostics & Wattage: Live ACPI discharge rate in real-time.
- Google Stitch OLED Neon Precision: True black design, 16px soft glass cards, and neon telemetry widgets.
